Completed the selected continuation chapters 2B, 3B, 6B, and 7B. No scores or ranking judgments were produced.

The workspace remained read-only; the manifest could not be persisted. Apply these ledger additions:

- `WEB-051` — Federal Government arms-delivery decision chain and end-use clauses; Defence Ministry review followed by Chancellery, Foreign Office, and Economy Ministry input; re-export requires German consent. Maps 2B.5, 2B.8–2B.9. [Source](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/fragen-und-anworten/faq-waffenlieferungen-2027766)
- `WEB-052` — 2023 German export licenses totaled €12.13bn; Ukraine €4.4bn, Israel €327m; only twelve end-use inspections since 2017, all for small arms and outside Ukraine/Israel. Maps 2B.5, 2B.8–2B.10. [Source](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1039486)
- `WEB-053` — Government claimed no evidence of German weapons used in Gaza and stated licenses should be denied where serious IHL violations are clearly risked. Official claim, not independent verification. Maps 2B.5, 2B.9–2B.10. [Source](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1009274)
- `WEB-054` — Bundestag debate records both Scholz’s Taurus restraint and contrary claims that delay could increase escalation risk. Maps 2B.1, 2B.3, 2B.8; contrary evidence. [Source](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2023/kw46-de-ukraine-976574)
- `WEB-055` — Official figures recorded 256,276 domestic-violence victims in 2023, approximately 70% female. Target-year burden; not Scholz causation. Maps 3B.7, 3B.10, 6B.2–6B.4. [Source](https://www.bmfsfj.de/bmfsfj/aktuelles/presse/pressemitteilungen/haeusliche-gewalt-im-jahr-2023-um-6-5-prozent-gestiegen-241062)
- `WEB-056` — Federal anti-violence program had €20.98m approved and €6.84m paid by October 2023; figures were provisional. Maps 3B.7, 6B.2–6B.4. [Source](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-974154)
- `WEB-057` — Destatis published the official 31 March 2023 prison-statistics report, confirming an accessible target-period detention dataset, though detailed tables were not extracted. Discovery/context only. [Source](https://www.destatis.de/DE/Themen/Staat/Justiz-Rechtspflege/Publikationen/Downloads-Strafverfolgung-Strafvollzug/statistischer-bericht-strafvollzug-2100410237005.html)
- `WEB-058` — Federal Anti-Discrimination Agency documented racial-profiling and police-discrimination complaints in its 2023 report. Maps 3B.2, 3B.4, 3B.7. [Source](https://www.antidiskriminierungsstelle.de/EN/homepage/_documents/annual_report_2023_englisch.pdf)
- `WEB-059` — The Federal Constitutional Court found routine handcuffing during prisoner medical transfers constitutionally and conventionally problematic without individualized proportionality assessment. Institutional judicial remedy, not Scholz-specific conduct. Maps 3B.4–3B.5. [Source](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Entscheidungen/EN/2023/01/rk20230119_2bvr171921en.html)
- `WEB-060` — Bürgergeld payment entitlements totaled approximately €42.6bn in 2023, with household-type breakdowns and average monthly claims. Maps 6B.1, 6B.4–6B.5, 6B.9. [Source](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1013412)
- `WEB-061` — 2023 net social-assistance spending was €17.6bn, while disability-integration assistance reached €25.4bn, up 9.4%; Bürgergeld was excluded. Maps 6B.2–6B.5, 6B.8–6B.10. [Source](https://www.destatis.de/DE/Presse/Pressemitteilungen/2024/08/PD24_295_221.html)
- `WEB-062` — 23.9% of German children under 18 were at risk of poverty or social exclusion in 2023. Household income uses prior-year income, limiting causal attribution to 2023 policy. Maps 6B.2–6B.3, 6B.8, 6B.10. [Source](https://www.destatis.de/DE/Presse/Pressemitteilungen/2024/07/PD24_N033_63.html)
- `WEB-063` — 7.9m people had severe disabilities at year-end 2023, including 214,000 children. Scale/context only; service quality not established. Maps 6B.4, 6B.8, 6B.10. [Source](https://www.destatis.de/DE/Presse/Pressemitteilungen/2024/07/PD24_281_227.html)
- `WEB-064` — BAMF published the nationwide 2023 integration-course business statistics, establishing a target-period administrative source; detailed PDF outcomes were not extracted. Maps 6B.5, 6B.8–6B.9. [Source](https://www.bamf.de/SharedDocs/Anlagen/DE/Statistik/Integrationskurszahlen/Bundesweit/2023-integrationskursgeschaeftsstatistik-gesamt_bund.html)
- `WEB-065` — Whistleblower Protection Act enacted in 2023, providing internal/external reporting channels, confidentiality, and retaliation protections. Coalition institutional reform, not personal Scholz evidence. Maps 7B.6–7B.8. [Source](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/hinschg/BJNR08C0B0023.html)
- `WEB-066` — Bundestag record documents the 2023 whistleblower-law debate and reporting-office design. Maps 7B.6–7B.8. [Source](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2023/kw19_de_schutz_hinweisgebender_personen-946698)
- `WEB-067` — Bundestag adopted lobby-register amendments requiring disclosure of concrete legislative or regulatory matters; proposals for an independent review body and broader contact documentation were rejected. Maps 7B.6–7B.8. [Source](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2023/kw42-de-lobbyregister-971428)
